name: Circuit Park Zandvoort
notes: Grand Prix circuit (clockwise). Raceway loop over today's track, which has the 2020 banked Hugenholtzbocht and Arie Luyendijkbocht; the 2013 lap was 4.307 km. Traced 4205 m. No DRS: it was not used at Zandvoort in 2013 for safety reasons. Start line on the pit straight, about 55% of the way to Tarzan (the pits sit at the start line in the game).
